tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find documentation pages and sections matching a query. Returns paths to pass to read_doc.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one documentation page as markdown. Paths: /, /developers, /about, /contact, /privacy, /trust, /changelog, /auth.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_doc" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read one documentation page as markdown. Paths: /, /developers, /about, /contact, /privacy, /auth." → after: "Read one documentation page as markdown. Paths: /, /developers, /about, /contact, /privacy, /trust, /changelog, /auth."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
